name: video
description: Accueil+ trailer (20 s, original synthesized soundtrack)

scripts.assets: mkdir -p public && cp ../docs/captures/{accueil,streaming,jeux,non-detectee,toutes,reglages}.png public/ && python3 -I scripts/make_music.py
scripts.render: npm run assets && remotion render Trailer ../docs/video/accueil-plus.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 && remotion render TrailerFR ../docs/video/accueil-plus-fr.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20
